label: US-WA-SB5886-digitallikeness-2026 Sec. 4

obligations.text: (2) Any person who infringes the rights under this chapter shall be (( liable for the greater of one thousand five hundred dollars or )) subject to a civil penalty of $3,000 and liable for the actual damages sustained as a result of the infringement, and any profits that are attributable to the infringement and not taken into account when calculating actual damages.

If the infringement is of a living or deceased individual's or personality's forged digital likeness, the infringing party shall also be liable for the noneconomic damages sustained as a result of the infringement whether or not the infringement resulted in any profit.

To prove profits under this section, the injured party or parties must submit proof of gross revenues attributable to the infringement, and the infringing party is required to prove his or her deductible expenses.
